Its process lineup includes waterjet cutting, tube laser, CNC press braking, sheet metal fabrication, tube and plate bending and rolling, precision milling and turning, 4-axis CNC foam carving, robotic-arm CNC machining, large-format 3D printing, plastic thermoforming, hard-coat finishing, and professional paint-booth work.

SRS Fabrication serves a broad range of industries, with explicit focus on industrial and architectural design, themed entertainment, scenic fabrication, environmental structural displays and fixtures, and custom set construction.
Typical customers include architectural firms, exhibit designers, entertainment production companies, and industrial clients needing one-off prototypes or low-volume assemblies.
